NUPHY-RELEASE-NOTES 1 version:1.2.40 [zh-CN] NuPhy Lab 1.2.40
• 新增 NODE75、NODE100 的 LP / HP 布局，以及 AIR65 V3、AIR100 V3 的 USB 适配和独立作品画布。 • 为兼容固件上的支持型号加入连接动画，按型号检查官方固件版本。 • NODE 触摸条保留原手势，AI 模式按需隔离与功能键共用的媒体输入，退出后恢复原键位。 • AIR65 V3 没有实体 F 区，不提供 F1–F12 自动接管。新增型号中，实体检查目前仅覆盖 NODE75 LP；其余型号仍需实机验证。 [en] NuPhy Lab 1.2.40
• Add USB profiles and separate artwork canvases for NODE75 and NODE100 LP / HP, AIR65 V3 and AIR100 V3. • Add the connection animation to supported models with compatible firmware, with model-specific official firmware checks. • Preserve NODE touch gestures while separating shared media inputs from AI function keys as needed; restore the original keymap when leaving AI mode. • AIR65 V3 has no physical function row and does not support automatic F1–F12 takeover. Among newly added models, physical checks currently cover NODE75 LP only; the other models still need hardware validation.
